injuries.name: CJ Donaldson
injuries.headline: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) listed as limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Donaldson wasn't able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday as he continues to recover from a shoulder issue. He should play in Week 7, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect much production out of him even if he's fully cleared.

injuries.name: Alvin Kamara
injuries.headline: Alvin Kamara (back) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Kamara was limited by a back injury on Wednesday, but that has been common for him over the course of the season and shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 7. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.

injuries.name: Rico Dowdle
injuries.headline: Rico Dowdle (knee) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran was limited on Wednesday as he continues to manage the nagging effects of a knee issue. He should be good to go for Week 7, however, and projects to continue to play second fiddle on Pittsburgh's offense behind Jaylen Warren moving forward.

injuries.name: Christian Kirk
injuries.headline: Christian Kirk (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Kirk was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, which bodes very well for his availability for Week 7. If active, he will see more work than usual in the event that Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) are ruled out against the Falcons.

injuries.name: Nick Bosa
injuries.headline: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) sidelined at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Bosa wasn't able to play for a fourth-straight game last week while he continues to recover from a pair of injuries. It seems more likely than not that he will be sidelined this week given that San Francisco has their bye week coming up in Week 8.

injuries.name: Charlie Jones
injuries.headline: Charlie Jones (Achilles) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran wideout was limited due to an Achilles issue on Wednesday. He is relegated almost entirely to special teams at this point in the season, however, so his status doesn't carry much weight for fantasy purposes.

injuries.name: Theo Johnson
injuries.headline: Theo Johnson (neck) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: Johnson didn't play due to a neck issue last week, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to be gearing up to play in Week 7. He won't be fantasy relevant even if active, however.

injuries.name: Dylan Parham
injuries.headline: Dylan Parham (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Parham has been sidelined for three-straight games while tending to a knee injury of some kind. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, however, which indicates that he may be close to healthy enough to suit up. New York's offensive front will see a boost if that's the case.

injuries.name: Adonai Mitchell
injuries.headline: Adonai Mitchell (finger) officially limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Mitchell has been out for several games while nursing a finger injury, but it seems that he is finally returning to form, as he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. His return this week would be less than ideal for rookie Omar Cooper Jr., who showed signs of a breakout last week.

injuries.name: Joseph Ossai
injuries.headline: Joseph Ossai (ankle) remains sidelined Wednesday
injuries.comment: Ossai wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise. He is week-to-week right now and is a long-shot to suit up for the Jets in Week 7.

injuries.name: Will Kacmarek
injuries.headline: Will Kacmarek (hamstring) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Kacmarek picked up a hamstring injury at some point and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. His potential absence this week wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes, however.

injuries.name: Jaylen Wright
injuries.headline: Jaylen Wright (foot) considered limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Wright was considered limited on Wednesday due to a foot injury that he's managing. He should play through it in Week 7 but will remain the RB2 for Miami behind Ollie Gordon II for the foreseeable future.

injuries.name: Caleb Douglas
injuries.headline: Caleb Douglas (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: The rookie seems to be doing much better after Miami's bye week. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday after missing several games with an ankle issue. His return would be good news for Miami's entire offense moving forward, though he isn't likely to have much individual fantasy value for the time being.

injuries.name: Jordan Mason
injuries.headline: Jordan Mason (thumb) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Mason seems to be trending the right direction for Week 7, as he was not limited in any way in his first official practice back on Wednesday. If he plays and has no workload restrictions this week, fantasy managers should consider starting him in a favorable matchup against the Colts.

injuries.name: Justin Jefferson
injuries.headline: Justin Jefferson (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: The Vikings chose to limit Jefferson's workload at practice on Wednesday, though he is likely close to full health after the team's bye week last week. He should play and continue to be a good fantasy option in Week 7, barring something unforeseen.

injuries.name: Brian O'Neill
injuries.headline: Brian O'Neill (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran is still listed on the injury report with a knee issue and was limited on Wednesday as a result. This has become a common occurrence for him over the course of the season, so the expectation is that he will continue to play through it again in Week 7.

injuries.name: Mike Washington Jr.
injuries.headline: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: Washington was left limited at Wednesday's practice. He's dealing with a couple of different injuries right now, and it's unclear if they will leave him with an injury designation heading into the weekend. Dylan Laube would see more work in the off-chance that Washington is out this week.

injuries.name: Kolton Miller
injuries.headline: Kolton Miller (shoulder) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran wasn't able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, as he's currently dealing with a shoulder issue of some kind. It doesn't look likely to leave him sidelined in Week 7, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

injuries.name: Brock Bowers
injuries.headline: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Bowers is dealing with two minor injuries right now. He's listed with a hamstring issue and a calf issue, which left him limited at Las Vegas' first practice of the week on Wednesday. Fantasy managers would be wise to keep tabs on his status throughout the rest of the week, although he doesn't seem to be at much risk of being sidelined on Sunday.

injuries.name: Trent Brown
injuries.headline: Trent Brown (wrist) sidelined from practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: The big man was unable to practice on Wednesday, as he's dealing with some kind of a wrist injury at the moment. This won't be a problem unless he still carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

injuries.name: Jaylen Waddle
injuries.headline: Jaylen Waddle (chest) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Waddle is now dealing with some kind of a chest injury and was left limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue at this point, but fantasy managers should continue to monitor his practice participation throughout the week to see if he'll play in Week 7. He remains a debatable starter in most league formats even if fully healthy, however.

injuries.name: Pat Surtain II
injuries.headline: Pat Surtain II (ankle) officially limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The Broncos have been without their star cornerback for a couple of weeks, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and will have a chance to play in Week 7. Denver's already-great defense will improve significantly whenever he's available to make his return to the lineup for them.

injuries.name: C.J. Henderson
injuries.headline: C.J. Henderson (groin) considered limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Henderson missed last week's game due to a groin issue. He's still dealing with it, but he was at least able to practice in a limited capacity on Wednesday. Atlanta's secondary will be much stronger if he's back in the lineup this week.

injuries.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
injuries.headline: Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran wasn't able to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he was left limited by a shoulder injury of some kind. Rookie Zachariah Branch may see more work if the veteran has to miss any time.

injuries.name: A.J. Terrell Jr.
injuries.headline: A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) officially limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Terrell was recently designated to return from injured reserve, so he came back to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. It may be another week or two before he's fully ready to go, but his return will be a nice boost for the Falcons whenever it comes.

injuries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
injuries.headline: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: Robinson's hamstring is a new issue for him. He was still able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, which indicates that it's not a very serious issue. It remains to be seen if it will cause him to be sidelined for a week or not.

injuries.name: Savion Williams
injuries.headline: Savion Williams (ankle) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Williams was unable to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he's still dealing with a nagging ankle issue. He was able to play through it last week, however, which suggests that he will do the same again this week.

injuries.name: Matthew Golden
injuries.headline: Matthew Golden (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: A shoulder issue left Golden limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday. It's not thought to be a serious issue at this point, so fantasy managers should tentatively plan on him playing as usual in Week 7, unless we hear a report to the contrary sometime in the next couple of days.

injuries.name: Aaron Banks
injuries.headline: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Banks was again limited at practice on Wednesday as he continues to manage a pair of injuries. Green Bay's offensive front will be much better in Week 7 if he's fully healthy and available to play against the Lions.

injuries.name: Jordan Love
injuries.headline: Jordan Love (back) officially limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Love is now dealing with some kind of a back issue. It left him limited at practice on Wednesday, but it doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue for the veteran quarterback at this point. Fantasy managers should not be concerned about his availability unless he carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

injuries.name: Christian Watson
injuries.headline: Christian Watson (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Watson is a new addition to the team's injury report, being listed with an ankle injury of some kind that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue, but fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week nonetheless.

injuries.name: Andrew Vorhees
injuries.headline: Andrew Vorhees (foot) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: Vorhees has been sidelined for two-straight practices due to a foot issue, but he was back at practice on Wednesday and seems to be trending towards playing in Week 7. His return would be good news for Baltimore's offensive front ahead of a matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

injuries.name: John Simpson
injuries.headline: John Simpson (groin) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran was limited by a groin issue on Wednesday. He has been able to play this issue recently, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to miss any time unless he suffers a setback with his recovery at some point.

injuries.name: Cam Jurgens
injuries.headline: Cam Jurgens (concussion) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: It looks like Jurgens is nearing full health again, which means that he is likely to make his debut as a member of the Ravens this week. His anticipated presence will offer a nice boost to Baltimore's offensive front moving forward.

injuries.name: Ronnie Stanley
injuries.headline: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Stanley practiced as a limited participant on Wednesday. He is listed with all of the same issues that he was last week, however, and he was able to play through them in Week 6. The expectation is that he will do the same again on Sunday.

injuries.name: Rashod Bateman
injuries.headline: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Bateman is dealing with a shoulder issue right now. The exact severity of it is unknown, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, so it appears to be more of a short-term issue. Rookie Ja'Kobi Lane will see more work in Week 7 if the veteran is unable to suit up.

injuries.name: Lamar Jackson
injuries.headline: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Jackson was able to make his return to practice on Wednesday and participated in a limited fashion. That's a big step in the right direction for his Week 7 availability, but the team isn't likely to make an official decision about his status until he has a couple more practices under his belt. Tyler Huntley will remain the starter for another week if Jackson still has to miss more time.

injuries.name: Beau Stephens
injuries.headline: Beau Stephens (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Stephens is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injuries.name: Rashid Shaheed
injuries.headline: Rashid Shaheed (hip) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Shaheed remains on the WR4/WR5 range for fantasy managers.

injuries.name: Drew Lock
injuries.headline: Drew Lock (elbow) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Lock will continue to backup Sam Darnold.

injuries.name: Tyrice Knight
injuries.headline: Tyrice Knight (oblique) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Knight is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injuries.name: Zach Charbonnet
injuries.headline: Zach Charbonnet (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Charbonnet remains on track to make his season debut on Sunday against the Chiefs.

injuries.name: Anthony Bradford
injuries.headline: Anthony Bradford (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Bradford is on track to have a chance to return for Sunday's game against Chiefs.

injuries.name: L'Jarius Sneed
injuries.headline: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Sneed is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

injuries.name: Trey Smith
injuries.headline: Trey Smith (hip) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Smith is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

injuries.name: Cooper McDonald
injuries.headline: Cooper McDonald (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: McDonald was designated to return to practice. His status for Sunday is uncertain.

injuries.name: Patrick Mahomes II
injuries.headline: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Mahomes will be good to go for Sunday's showdown in Seattle.

injuries.name: Travis Kelce
injuries.headline: Travis Kelce (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Kelce is being managed in practice to start the week. He should be good to go in his usual role for Sunday.

injuries.name: Chamarri Conner
injuries.headline: Chamarri Conner (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Conner is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

injuries.name: Cyrus Allen
injuries.headline: Cyrus Allen (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Allen is likely to be good to go on Sunday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

injuries.name: Calvin Ridley
injuries.headline: Calvin Ridley (hip) listed as limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Ridley is managing a hip issue and was relegated to a limited role at practice on Wednesday as a result. It remains to be seen if he will have an injury designation going into Week 7, but either way he remains off of the fantasy radar at this point.

injuries.name: KC Concepcion Jr.
injuries.headline: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: The rookie is currently dealing with a pair of injuries and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. They could affect his availability or workload for Week 7, but we won't know more until later on in the week.

injuries.name: Tytus Howard
injuries.headline: Tytus Howard (knee) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran was a limited participant to start the week on Wednesday. He has been playing through his knee issue recently, however, so he's likely to do so again in Week 7.

injuries.name: Dylan Sampson
injuries.headline: Dylan Sampson (knee) officially limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Sampson has been on injured reserve since the start of the season due to a persistent knee issue of some kind, but he seems to be nearly over it and was able to participate in Wednesday's practice in a limited fashion. He seems likely to play in Week 7, which would be bad news for the workload of Audric Estime and Jaleel McLaughlin moving forward.
